verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll/PEO SaaS, so API parity with the UI is a fair question. The evidence pack shows only UI-driven workflows (navigation menus, buttons) and a Xero integration. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt (both 404), so nothing documents a public API, let alone one with UI parity. The help center URL path containing '/api/v2/' belongs to the Zendesk help-center host, not to Justworks' product, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
